mapper.select: SELECT id,vendor_id,status,goods_amount,shipping_fee FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_assist_requests WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_assist_requests WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status <>'cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{id} AND carrier_verify_status='approved' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE t_assist_requests SET assistant_id=#{actor},status='accepted' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending'
UPDATE t_assist_requests SET status='cancelled' WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('pending','accepted')
UPDATE t_assist_requests SET status='carrying',handover_a_urls=#{urls},handover_a_city=#{city},handover_a_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='accepted'
UPDATE t_assist_requests SET status='done',handover_b_urls=#{urls},handover_b_city=#{city},finished_at=NOW(3),settled_amount=#{amount} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='carrying'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notifications(id,user_id,kind,title,body) SELECT UUID(),id,'assist','新的协带单可接',CONCAT('有带单人发布协带需求，分润 ',#{rate},'%，去接单大厅看看。') FROM t_profiles WHERE carrier_verify_status='approved' AND id <> #{actor} LIMIT 20
